description: Baseline P0-P3 acceptance scan; existing migration snapshot ancestry check fails before implementation changes.

asi.hypothesis: Establish objective baseline before implementing roadmap gates.
asi.rollback_reason: Repository baseline contract suite has a migration snapshot ancestry mismatch unrelated to the new autoresearch harness.
asi.next_action_hint: Diagnose and repair the existing migration snapshot chain first so later improvements can be kept.

description: Reconciled order confirmation with ADR-0033 and repaired migration ancestry; process PostgreSQL tests exposed an accounting period date bug.

asi.hypothesis: Server-derived order lines and accounting profiles will close the ADR-0033 reconciliation gate.
asi.rollback_reason: Accounting period lookup still reports closed despite an open 2000-2099 period; changes reverted by experiment harness.
asi.next_action_hint: Fix utcDate: tests run with the Effect test clock at epoch, so posting date resolves to 1970-01-01. Use a provided current date/test clock or open period covering epoch in process tests, then reapply the captured ADR-0033 diff.
asi.learned: The production service uses Clock.Clock, and @effect/vitest supplies a test clock unless explicitly live; date-sensitive PostgreSQL tests must control/provide clock intentionally.

description: Align order confirmation with ADR-0033 and repair the migration snapshot ancestry chain.

asi.hypothesis: Server-derived order lines and accounting posting close the superseded workflow gap without broadening architecture.
asi.result: Process now reserves Sales-owned lines, derives revenue from order total, and no longer accepts client journal facts; tests and repository checks pass.
asi.test_clock_note: Date-sensitive @effect/vitest integration fixtures cover the epoch-based test clock explicitly.

description: Reconciled P0 and roadmap wording, but the current coarse metric already counted the conditional P0 readiness sentence.

asi.hypothesis: Explicit P0 closure and roadmap reconciliation would close an uncounted acceptance gate.
asi.rollback_reason: No primary metric improvement because the harness's P0 grep already treated 'P0 is READY only when...' as closure.
asi.next_action_hint: Bundle these documentation corrections with the next substantive P1 improvement, and later tighten the harness wording check without claiming a standalone gain.
asi.useful_changes: P0 explicit READY status; fiscal periods PARTIAL; process distinguished from Process Studio.

description: Accept the P1 inventory primitive baseline and reconcile P0/roadmap status.

asi.hypothesis: A narrow discrete-stock baseline resolves P1 without speculative conversion, traceability, valuation, or location hierarchy.
asi.result: ADR-0035 defines Item UOM, whole quantities, warehouse location, non-negative stock, append-only correction, and explicit non-goals; P0 is explicitly closed and roadmap drift is corrected.
asi.deferred: Implementation of UOM DTOs and idempotent correction command remains the next gate.

description: Implemented P1 UOM and correction semantics; one PostgreSQL assertion still queried the removed enum value.

asi.hypothesis: An idempotent signed adjustment command plus immutable item UOM closes the P1 implementation gate.
asi.rollback_reason: The integration test counted corrections with kind='adjustment' after implementation intentionally encoded correction direction as existing receipt/issue kinds to avoid unsafe same-transaction enum evolution.
asi.next_action_hint: Reapply/retain the P1 patch and change the movement-count assertion to filter by correction idempotency key or non-null correction metadata, then rerun.
asi.migration_learning: Using existing receipt/issue direction plus correction metadata avoids PostgreSQL's unsafe-use-of-new-enum-value migration failure.

description: Implement immutable Item UOM and idempotent append-oriented stock corrections for the P1 baseline.

asi.hypothesis: A single-unit discrete-stock contract and signed idempotent correction command provide the minimum executable P1 proof.
asi.result: Inventory now defaults/normalizes UOM, validates correction units, serializes negative corrections against reserved stock, and preserves correction history with tenant-scoped idempotency.
asi.validation: Inventory unit/PostgreSQL tests, migration catalog, db check, boundary lint, type check, and contract checks passed.
asi.migration_design: Corrections reuse receipt/issue movement direction plus correction metadata, avoiding a PostgreSQL enum migration transaction hazard.

description: Define and enforce the P2 document, fixed-scale money, revenue period, and reversal baseline.

asi.hypothesis: Owner-local documents plus a fixed two-decimal Legal Entity posting baseline resolve P2 without inventing invoice, payment, tax, or settlement policy.
asi.result: ADR-0036 establishes document/correction ownership; accounting now enforces precision 2 at Schema and PostgreSQL boundaries with open/closed-period and idempotent reversal proofs.
asi.validation: Focused accounting contract/PostgreSQL tests, migration checks, boundary checks, type checks, and repository contract checks passed.
asi.explicit_non_goals: Tax, AP/AR, invoices, payments, settlement, reopen, adjusting periods, FX, and multi-currency remain unpublished until separately decided.
